# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.21

This release publishes the Administrator-only **Live RX Phones** board, the
portable fresh-server installer, and the corrected Windows pending-service
startup handling after clearing the high-severity dependency audit gate.

## Live RX Phones

- Shows configured and paired RX Softphone workstations in an Administrator-only,
  view-only FOP-style presence board.
- Shows registration, relay heartbeat, idle/dialing/ringing/connected state,
  active peer, live duration, shared-extension count, Windows device, and last
  reported call.
- Does not listen to audio, record calls, dial, hang up, control calls, or query
  unrelated PBX extensions.

## New-server deployment

- Includes the portable guided Windows installer introduced in `next.19`.
- Accepts NSSM `StartPending` as a normal transition and continues to the
  exact-version application health gate.

## Dependency security

- Removes the obsolete Sequelize CLI dependency and routes setup migrations
  through the audited NEXT lifecycle engine.
- Uses patched `gaxios` 7.3.0 for the Google API client.
- Passes the high-severity npm audit gate with no high or critical findings.

No database migration or data reset is required. RX Softphone remains version
0.6.0.
